title: credit-correction/v1
description: targets/<id>/credit-corrections/<timestamp>-<curator>.yaml (F07-T66; D-18, D-19 v3.27): a listed curator corrects one ledger line of this target, reviewed like any curator record (F08-R8). It names the line as ledger/v1 identifies it (merge_commit, line, node, artifact, and route_class on an attempts line; the target is the directory it is filed under), the identity it credits (`from`) and the identity that should hold it (`to`, or null for none), and a reason. The post-merge job applies it: `from`'s entry becomes `revoked` and an `active` copy is written to `to`'s ledger. An entry is never deleted, and applying a correction twice changes nothing. Append-only; versioned, never edited (D-34).

merge_commit.description: The merge the ledger line records, as ledger/v1's merge_commit.

line.description: Which of D-19's six lines, as ledger/v1's line.

artifact.description: As ledger/v1's artifact: the file the entry is for, relative to the node directory.

route_class.description: On an attempts line, ledger/v1's route_class; absent otherwise.

from.description: The identity the ledger credits now: a ledger/v1 identity.

to.description: The identity that should hold the line, or null for none (the line is revoked and nobody holds it).

reason.description: Why, in the curator's words: the published reasoning a correction owes the record (D-22).
